name: Spectator
description: (Tag:illusion)(Tag:implant)(Tag:perception+)Dubbed "Almighty Five Sights", Spectator is a bonding mechanical third-eye Teigu that massively boosts vision to read minute muscle movements, see through objects, and project sight like a camera to predict opponents. Its trump card makes a target perceive you as a loved one. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.
